cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: What Aren’t You Saying?
cards.instruction: Find out what someone is holding back by treating every careful answer as incomplete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. These minutes say 'discussion of my proposal.' What did you leave out?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sign them and we can eat. Nobody wanted an awkward record.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. 'Nobody' sounds crowded. Who wanted my name out of it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I did. I suggested someone else present, to save your proposal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Who else? You've recorded my rescue very carefully without naming my replacement.

mechanism: A withholds approval of minutes until their careful wording yields the omitted advocate and replacement presenter.
confusable: D64 maps backers and beneficiaries; D102 treats careful answers themselves as evidence more is withheld.
comparison: Formal minutes and signature pressure differ from a sibling protecting audition feelings.
seedUse: Use D102-b nobody admission and unnamed replacement, making A signature gate govern successive disclosure.
